images.title: A kite and a parallelogram with the same sides
images.purpose: Show the concept's own two shapes: the kite with sides 5 cm, 5 cm, 3 cm and 3 cm in order, whose equal sides are next to each other, and the parallelogram with sides 5 cm, 3 cm, 5 cm and 3 cm in order, whose equal sides are opposite.
images.composition: Two shapes side by side, each with its 4 sides numbered 1 to 4 round the shape, labelled in cm and ticked so that equal sides carry the same ticks.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816, two shapes side by side, drawn to scale (70 px for every 1 cm). HEADINGS: the text Sides in order: 5, 5, 3, 3 centred at (370,100) and the text Sides in order: 5, 3, 5, 3 centred at (1070,100), bold dark #1F2937 sans-serif, 38 px. LEFT SHAPE, exactly 1 kite with 4 corners (370,190) (top), (202,497) (left), (370,623) (bottom) and (538,497) (right), filled teal #0072B2 with a thin dark #2B2B2B outline (3 px). Its 2 upper sides are each about 350 px long (5 cm) and its 2 lower sides are each 210 px long (3 cm). Exactly 4 white side numbers, bold 34 px, inside the kite next to the sides: 1 at (335,370) (upper left side), 2 at (405,370) (upper right side), 3 at (420,515) (lower right side) and 4 at (320,515) (lower left side). Equal-sides ticks in reddish purple #CC79A7, 5 px thick, 32 px long, crossing the sides at their middles: exactly 1 tick on each of the 2 upper sides, (300,351) to (272,336) and (440,351) to (468,336), and exactly 2 ticks side by side on each of the 2 lower sides, (449,544) to (468,569) and (440,551) to (459,576) and (300,551) to (281,576) and (291,544) to (272,569). Side labels, bold dark 34 px: 5 cm centred at (247,322) and 5 cm centred at (493,322) outside the upper sides, 3 cm centred at (480,595) and 3 cm centred at (260,595) outside the lower sides. Under the kite the text Kite (bold dark, 48 px, centred at (370,690)) and under it the text adjacent sides are equal (dark, 30 px, centred at (370,735)). RIGHT SHAPE, exactly 1 parallelogram with 4 corners (832,524) (bottom left), (1182,524) (bottom right), (1308,356) (top right) and (958,356) (top left), filled amber #E69F00 with the same outline. Its top and bottom sides are 350 px long (5 cm) and its 2 slanted sides are 210 px long (3 cm). Exactly 4 dark side numbers, bold 34 px, inside the shape next to the sides: 1 at (1133,412) (top), 2 at (1200,406) (right slanted side), 3 at (1007,468) (bottom) and 4 at (940,474) (left slanted side). Equal-sides ticks in reddish purple, 5 px thick, 32 px long: exactly 1 tick on each of the top and bottom sides, (1133,372) to (1133,340) and (1007,508) to (1007,540), and exactly 2 ticks side by side on each of the 2 slanted sides, (1236,426) to (1261,445) and (1229,435) to (1254,454) and (904,454) to (879,435) and (911,445) to (886,426). Side labels, bold dark 34 px: 5 cm centred at (1133,312) above the top side and 5 cm centred at (1007,568) below the bottom side, 3 cm centred at (1280,466) and 3 cm centred at (860,414) outside the slanted sides. Under the parallelogram the text Parallelogram (bold dark, 48 px, centred at (1070,690)) and under it the text opposite sides are equal (dark, 30 px, centred at (1070,735)). No diagonal lines and no other marks. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
any number written on an angle, and any angle-measuring tool, anywhere in the frame
any shape drawn out of proportion to the stated side lengths
a kite whose 2 upper sides are not equal or whose 2 lower sides are not equal
more or fewer than 4 side numbers on a shape
images.takeaway: Both shapes have two 5 cm sides and two 3 cm sides. In the kite the equal sides touch at a corner (adjacent); in the parallelogram the equal sides face each other (opposite).
images.description: A kite with sides 5 cm, 5 cm, 3 cm and 3 cm next to a parallelogram with sides 5 cm, 3 cm, 5 cm and 3 cm, with equal sides ticked alike.
images.context: Concept image for Kites. It follows the idea of the figures in your maths book (a kite with its sides numbered 1 to 4, side 1 = side 2 and side 3 = side 4) and shows the concept's own example of sides 5 cm, 5 cm, 3 cm and 3 cm.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the child to read the sides in order, starting at the top, before looking at the ticks. The slip to watch is saying a kite has equal opposite sides: it is the parallelogram that has.

image_decisions.why: Two shapes with the same side lengths in a different order show that only the order of the sides tells a kite from a parallelogram.
